Saturday Ride (One Cycling)

Ottawa, Canada · Social

Saturday Ride (One Cycling) is a social group ride in Ottawa, Canada. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am local time from Parking Lot P3, Gatineau Park (Oct 3, 2026); the start changes weekly.

For visitors

Open Meetup group; join the group and RSVP on the event. Helmets strongly recommended, bring two bottles of water and a snack. The group runs an after-work social at The Waverley on Elgin most second Thursdays. It also has a Strava club.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy rides most weeks (Hogs Back, Britannia, Jacques-Cartier Park to Pink Lake); Oct 3 is hilly, 700 m of climbing.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Saturday Ride (One Cycling) group ride

A community cycling group in Ottawa-Gatineau that rides most Saturdays, often with a coffee or ice cream stop. Routes run along the river paths and into Gatineau Park. The group describes itself as made up of many cultures and languages, and posts in English and French.
